Adding Vanessa — Ops. We should reissue the invite with a Zoom primary link and put the Meet link in a secondary location. Outlook desktop is notorious for stripping certain HTML bits in the body of forwarded invites; the safe approach is:

- Create a new event where the organizer is a Redwood calendar service account (reduces cross-org metadata Outlook scrubbing).
- Use the Zoom meeting join in the event "Location" field and the first line of the event body (plain text).
- Include the .ics but also paste the full Zoom join URL as plaintext at the top — Outlook will show that even if it strips <a> tags.
- Tag the external as "Novix Demo — Zoom primary" so their calendar shows the join URL.

Vanessa — can you recreate the invite with the above pattern and send it as the organizer from the Redwood demo account? Mark me and Chloe as co-hosts.

—Ben
